verdict.rationale: Brex's developer APIs (Accounting, Budgets, Webhooks, Team) are for managing spend/expense data on Brex's own corporate card/cash accounts, not for embedding banking-as-a-service accounts for third-party customers under a BaaS model. No evidence of a BaaS/embedded finance offering exists in the pack; instead, community evidence shows Brex is restrictive and inconsistent even with its own account holders.
